description: This file provides utility functions for handling ANSI escape sequences, grapheme segmentation, and string sanitization, primarily for terminal output processing.

methods.name: stripAnsi
methods.description: Removes ANSI escape sequences related to OSC-8 hyperlinks and CSI sequences from input string.

methods.name: splitGraphemes
methods.description: Splits input string into grapheme clusters, using Intl.Segmenter if available.

methods.name: sanitizeForLog
methods.description: Sanitizes a string for safe logging by removing ANSI sequences and control characters to prevent injection.

methods.name: visibleWidth
methods.description: Calculates the display width of a string considering grapheme clusters and character width properties.
